messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a tf apply for cross-account IAM role update in the 18:00 UTC release window. Need provider pin and rollback plan. Will affect peering roles in prod and staging. workspace=prod, module=iam/peers

aj: ack. what's the provider version you want pinned?

maria: pin to registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws v4.56.0 — reason: provider doc change caused auth drift on 4.57. will add to release notes. planning canary in staging 30m before prod.

sam: Deploybot note: set deploybot.pin to aws@4.56.0 and disable auto-bump for the window. I'll trigger staging apply at 17:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

deploybot: deploybot: Pin set: aws -> 4.56.0 for branch release/2026-05. Auto-upgrades suspended until 2026-05-02T00:00:00Z

jing: For rollback: if assume-role fails, restore previous policy and run `terraform apply -target=module.iam_peers -auto-approve` against the tagged commit? That will be our targeted rollback.

nick: Suggest a safer rollback: keep previous role ARN in a variable and switch traffic via routing rule — for IAM, the fastest safe move is to re-apply the previous policy version from the git tag. Avoid `state rm` unless absolutely necessary.

maria: OK Plan A (preferred): staged apply in staging -> verify canary -> prod apply. Plan B (rollback): restore previous policy file from tag v2026-04-27 and run targeted apply `-target=module.iam_peers`, then notify SRE runbook.

sam: Adding to release notes: short blurb about IAM trust change and required post-deploy validation steps (k8s nodes must be able to assume role). Also include rollback steps and runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/iam-rollbacks

aj: Who will be on-call for the 18:00 UTC window?

maria: I'll be primary; backup is aj. pager: @oncall-eng

leo: small preflight: `terraform plan -out=plan.tfplan -target=module.iam_peers` shows 2 adds 1 change in staging. snippet:
```
# module.iam_peers
~ aws_iam_role.trust (new policy version)
+ aws_iam_policy_attachment.peer-attach
```

sam: good. recommend adding `--refresh=false` to speed canary plans.

deploybot: deploy scheduled: staging apply at 2026-05-01T17:00:00Z, prod at 2026-05-01T18:00:00Z. If prod apply fails, automatic circuit: fallback to aws@4.55.3 within 10m and alert @oncall-eng.

maria: confirm — set deploybot threshold to fail if >20% of canary instances report assume-role error within 5m. then abort and kick off rollback runbook.

deploybot: threshold set. Good luck :crossed_fingers: 

aj: lgtm. I'll prepare the release notes diff and ping legal/security for quick review.

maria: thanks. Will post an ops status msg 30m before canary. End.
